topology_reasoning: The binary image shows a symmetric 1x2 adiabatic splitter. A broad central input waveguide enters from the left. Two narrow outer arms begin after a short offset, linearly widen over most of the footprint, and then follow mirrored smooth S-bends to the upper and lower outputs. The central guide narrows linearly to a tip and terminates between the two arms. This is a three-guide adiabatic/Y-splitter-like topology, not a directional coupler: there is no parallel constant-width coupling section and the center guide ends before the output bends. Function-defining knobs are input width, output arm width, taper length, tip width, initial arm offset, arm separation, bend length/offset, and bend smoothing.
